<a id="valkyries_on_parade"></a>
## The Ride of the Valkyries as a New Orleans Brass Band: `valkyries_on_parade.yml`

Valkyries on parade: the Ride of the Valkyries as a New Orleans brass band on the street. The horn
theme of the Ride of the Valkyries (Richard Wagner, 1856) is public domain and is played as written,
in its key and its nine-eight time, from Claude's knowledge of the score; the sousaphone's line, the
saxophones' riff, the trumpet's and trombone's shouts, the solos and the parade drums are new.
